title: Learfield Directors’ Cup Festival to celebrate WashU Bears
summary_en: WashU will celebrate its first Learfield Directors’ Cup with a festival and a women’s soccer game on Wednesday, Sept. 23. Athletic Director Anthony Azama says the honor reflects the competitive spirit of WashU student athletes.
title_cn: Learfield Directors’ Cup Festival to celebrate WashU Bears

title: Gut microbiome features predict devastating disease affecting preemies
summary_en: WashU Medicine researchers found that bacteria-infecting viruses and bacterial antibiotic resistance genes in the gut microbiomes of premature babies play an important role in necrotizing enterocolitis, a sudden and often fatal intestinal illness.
title_cn: Gut microbiome features predict devastating disease affecting preemies

title: Hotchner Festival highlights WashU playwrights
summary_en: Three new plays by Chinonso Anyanwu, Anna Schwartz and Frauke Thielecke will receive world premiere staged readings Sept. 19 and 20 as part of the 2026 A.E. Hotchner Playwriting Festival.

title: University to retire Robert J. Terry Lecture, rename professorship
summary_en: Washington University in St. Louis will retire the Robert J. Terry Lecture and rename the Robert J. Terry Professorship, following approval by the Board of Trustees. The action follows a recommendation from the university’s Naming Review Board and concludes a yearlong review.
title_cn: University to retire Robert J. Terry Lecture, rename professorship
